rows.value:
select 1
				from Lemma
				where SavedReference = @SavedReference and IsStop

select dt.Value
					from {0} r join DisplayText dt on r.DisplayTextId = dt.Id
					where r.SavedReference = @SavedReference
					order by dt.Id;

select l.Id, dt.Value
					from Lemma l join DisplayText dt on l.DisplayTextId = dt.Id
					where l.SavedReference = @SavedReference
					order by l.Id;

select r.Id, r.SavedReference, dt.Value
					from Root r
						join DisplayText dt on r.DisplayTextId = dt.Id
						join LemmaRoot lr on r.Id = lr.RootId
					where lr.LemmaId =
					(
						select Id
						from Lemma
						where SavedReference = @SavedReference
					)
					order by r.Id;

select gf.Article, gf.Gender, gf.Suffix, gf.Surface
					from GreekGenitiveForm gf
					where gf.LemmaId =
					(
						select Id
						from Lemma
						where SavedReference = @SavedReference
					)
					order by gf.Id;

select pp.PresentActive, pp.FutureActive, pp.AoristActive, pp.PerfectActive, pp.PerfectMiddlePassive, pp.AoristPassive
					from GreekVerbPrincipalParts pp
					where pp.LemmaId =
					(
						select Id
						from Lemma
						where SavedReference = @SavedReference
					)
					order by pp.Id;

select lklown.SavedReference
				from LemmaKeyLinkOverrideWordNumber lklown join Lemma l on lklown.LemmaId = l.Id
				where l.SavedReference = @SavedReference
				order by lklown.Id;

select l.Id, l.SavedReference, dt.Value
						from Lemma l join DisplayText dt on l.DisplayTextId = dt.Id join FoldedText ft on l.FoldedTextId = ft.Id
						where ft.Value = @FoldedValue
						order by l.Id;

select r.Id, r.SavedReference, dt.Value
						from Root r join DisplayText dt on r.DisplayTextId = dt.Id join FoldedText ft on r.FoldedTextId = ft.Id
						where ft.Value = @FoldedValue
						order by r.Id;

select wb.Id, wb.SavedReference, dt.Value
						from WordBase wb join DisplayText dt on wb.DisplayTextId = dt.Id join FoldedText ft on wb.FoldedTextId = ft.Id
						where ft.Value = @FoldedValue
						order by wb.Id;

select AnalysisGroupId
				from {0}AnalysisGroup
				where {0}Id = @Id
				order by AnalysisGroupId;

select g.Text
				from Gloss g join {0}Gloss rg on g.Id = rg.GlossId
				where
					g.Language = @Language and
					rg.{0}Id = @Id and
					rg.AnalysisGroupId = @AnalysisGroupId
				order by rg.Id;

select g.Text, rg.AnalysisGroupId
				from Gloss g join {0}Gloss rg on g.Id = rg.GlossId
				where
					g.Language = @Language and
					rg.{0}Id = @Id
				order by rg.Id;

select r.SavedReference
				from Root r join LemmaRoot lr on r.Id = lr.RootId
				where lr.LemmaId = @LemmaId
				order by r.Id;

select l.SavedReference
				from Lemma l join Lemma{0} lr on l.Id = lr.LemmaId
				where lr.{0}Id = @Id
				order by l.Id;

select l.SavedReference, lag.AnalysisGroupId
				from Lemma l
					join LemmaRoot lr on l.Id = lr.LemmaId
					join LemmaAnalysisGroup lag on l.Id = lag.LemmaId
				where lr.RootId = @RootId
				order by l.Id;

select le.Id
				from LemmaEquivalent le join Lemma l on le.LemmaId = l.Id
				where l.SavedReference = @SavedReference
				order by le.Id;

select l.SavedReference
				from Lemma l join EquivalentComponentLemma ecl on l.Id = ecl.LemmaId
				where ecl.LemmaEquivalentId = @LemmaEquivalentId
				order by ComponentIndex;

select Id from AnalysisGroup
				where
					Analysis = @Analysis and
					Language = @Language and
					Corpus = @Corpus and
					Variant is @Variant;

select Id, Analysis, Language, Corpus, Variant, Priority
				from AnalysisGroup;
